exceptions.reason: Temporary risk acceptance for the existing synthetic-data demo, explicitly approved by the repository owner. The release scan confirmed this HIGH finding in the AI image; backend and frontend acceptance is conditional on the identical CVE and source package/version. Debian lists gcc-14 14.2.0-19 as vulnerable with no fixed Trixie version. The flaw concerns integer overflow in libstdc++ aligned operator new. Native dependency reachability and the compiled allocation implementation remain unverified and are accepted residual risk. Applies only to this exact CVE, source package/version and listed repositories through 2026-10-30.

exceptions.reviewed_by: Repository owner (explicit renewal approval in Codex conversation on 2026-10-03)
exceptions.reason: OpenSSL rates this Low. It affects only TLS servers that call SSL_set_SSL_CTX() during a handshake with a replacement context supporting more provider signature algorithms. No container terminates TLS: uvicorn and Streamlit serve plain HTTP behind the ALB HTTPS listener, and the services use OpenSSL only as a TLS client. Debian lists the exact Trixie package as vulnerable with no fixed version; upstream fixes it in OpenSSL 3.5.9.

exceptions.reason: OpenSSL rates this Low. It affects only OpenSSL QUIC endpoints receiving NEW_CONNECTION_ID frames. No service uses QUIC or HTTP/3; outbound HTTPS uses TCP-based TLS clients. Debian lists the exact Trixie package as vulnerable with no fixed version; upstream fixes it in OpenSSL 3.5.9.

exceptions.reason: Temporary risk acceptance for the existing synthetic-data demo. The Debian tracker rates this a minor issue and marks trixie no-dsa; the exact Trixie package 2.41-12+deb13u4 has no fixed version, upstream fixed it in glibc 2.43. The out-of-bounds write is confined to the deprecated ns_printrrf/ns_printrr/fp_nquery DNS debugging functions when printing TSIG records, reachable only from DNS server or resolver tooling; no service runs such tooling and the AI service is private-subnet-only. Native dependency reachability remains unverified and is accepted residual risk. Applies only to this exact CVE, package name/version and listed repositories through 2026-10-30.
